# 4 bed bungalow for sale

> ***4 BEDROOM BUNGALOW AND GARAGE ON C.0.64 ACRES*** Killian Lynch Auctioneers are pleased to present this spacious 4 bedroom bungalow and garage set on a private site of C.0.64 acres. The property which comprises of C.1,700 sq ft living accommodation boasts a bright open plan kitchen/dining room, generous living room and also has a converted attic.
